author: Little Chinese Everywhere
description:
If you want to experience the China you see in our videos, come travel with us:
https://littlechineseeverywhere.com/tours

In this video, we visit a Miao village in southern Guizhou, close to the Guangxi border.
The Miao are one of China's 56 officially recognized ethnic groups, with their own language, traditions and cultural celebrations.
Quite unexpectedly, we stumbled upon their first rice harvest celebration! This is a particularly meaningful occasion, as rice was traditionally their main source of food throughout the year.
During the festivities, we also got to experience the sound of the lusheng, a fascinating bamboo wind instrument that looks a little like a traditional church organ.
The whole atmosphere was incredibly welcoming and charming, and we're happy we got to experience this special moment.
